EmailTemplate.subject: Congratulations on your admission to Arizona State University!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Congratulations, you have been admitted to Arizona State University!
Please find your admission letter attached to this email. You may use this admit letter for your visa interview or SEVIS transfer form.
Best regards,
International Admission Services
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
